priority_semantics: P0 - release-blocking: required by the final release acceptance criteria (area 6) or a hard safety/prerequisite gate. Do not ship without it.
P1 - required for a coherent, useful final product; can run in parallel once P0 foundations land.
P2 - advanced evolution planned by the Master Blueprint; after the core release.
P3 - polish / optional distribution extras and long-term maintenance.
status_semantics: verified - implemented AND proven in this repository by a named test, a measured command, or both recorded in Evidence.
partial - implemented or usable but unverified, limited, or missing acceptance evidence (e.g. components exist but are not wired).
planned - specified but absent, or only a static placeholder exists.
blocked - the acceptance depends on an incomplete earlier phase/integration; no amount of local work on it alone can make it pass.

core.label: Area 1 - CrewAI + CrewAI Flows first-class integration
core.description: CrewAI as a first-class engine dependency (not a cloned vendor checkout), agent/task/crew execution with verified gates, and complete CrewAI Flows integration for product workflows.

studio.label: Area 2 - Studio GUI + multimodal chat
studio.description: Professional NL-branded Studio shell; multimodal mission chat (drag-and-drop, Ctrl+V screenshots, attachments), media/ASR/TTS backends, IDE tools (editor/terminal/Git/tests/debug/LSP/MCP), accessibility and non-blocking UX.

autonomy.label: Area 3 - Universal autonomous development
autonomy.description: Persistent goals/milestones/tasks/missions, dynamic teams, model competence evidence, resource scheduling, permissions/tool registry, supervised execution on arbitrary projects, independent gates, staged changes, safe rollback; the indexed blueprint is the durable specification.

hygiene.label: Area 4 - Repository hygiene
hygiene.description: Read-only audits, removal of duplicate/generated/obsolete artifacts, consolidated build outputs, one verified candidate, no destructive action without explicit authorization.

distribution.label: Area 5 - Lightweight installation + portable distribution
distribution.description: Online native bootstrapper, private runtimes into a user-selected location, no global Python/pip/uv/conda, optional components and offline packages, repair/update/cache management, shared downloads without isolation loss, Windows/Linux/macOS verified builds.

release.label: Area 6 - Release acceptance criteria
release.description: Evidence gates for the final product: non-default install path; clean Windows without global Python; relocation survival; clipboard screenshot + drag-and-drop attachments; mic + local transcription; CrewAI workflows and autonomous missions execute; invalid agent edits cannot corrupt verified sources; local model discovery + evidence-based selection; reproducible organized builds.
